violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal Foods Different Types
violations.observation: Different types of raw animal foods stored in such a manner that may cause cross contamination as follows: 1) observed Raw ground beef being stored above Raw bacon in the walk-in cooler
violations.corrective_action: Raw animal foods shall be sorted by their 'type' and cooking temperatures while in storage inside a refrigerator or freezer. For example, if using ONE shelving unit for storage of ONLY raw foods, the foods shall be sorted in this manner: 1) raw poultry (chicken, turkey, or duck) shall be stored on the BOTTOM shelf (165F cook temperature), 2) raw ground beef and ground pork shall be stored on the shelf above poultry (155F cook temperature), and 3) raw pork (chops, ribs), seafood, and shell eggs shall be stored on the top shelf above beef (145F cook temperature). PIC MOVED SWITCHED THE POSITIONS OF THE RAW PRODUCTS SO THAT THE RAW GROUND BEEF WAS BELOW THE RAW BACON.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: 1) in the 1DR under counter Coffee cooler: half and half (45f)
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. FRONT OF HOUSE MANAGER DISCARDED THE HALF AND HALF. Tatte Bakery & Cafe (Inspection Date: 06/17/2026) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Chemicals Used on Raw Produce
violations.observation: When tested with PIC’s vegetable wash test kit, the concentration was observed higher than the acceptable levels.
violations.corrective_action: Chemicals used to wash or peel, raw whole fruits and vegetables must be approved as food additives or recognized as safe. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC TO EITHER; 1) DILUTE THE VEGETABLE WASH WITH WATER BFEORE USING; 2) DISCONTINUE USING THE VEGETABLE WASH UNTIL THE DISPENSER IS RECALIBRATED; 3) DISCONTINUE USING THE VEGETABLE WASH AND WASH ALL PRODUCE WITH WATER. PIC AGREE TO DISCONTINUE USE.

violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: 1) 1DR under counter Coffee cooler

violations.title: Food Packaged, Label Information
violations.observation: Insufficient information about the pasteurization is provided on the label of the following food item(s) packaged in the food establishment: 1) orange juice. 2) pear juice. 3) lemonade. Upon discussion with PIC, prepackaged orange juice and pear juice are pasteurized
violations.corrective_action: Food packaged in a food establishment for customer self service shall include labels that contain the following information: 1. the common name of the food, 2. the list of major ingredients including artificial colors or preservatives, 3. the total net weight or quantity of the food, 4. the name and place of business of the food manufacturer, packer, or distributor, 5. the name of the food source for each major food allergen contained in the food,6. nutrition labeling and, 7. for any salmonid fish containing canthaxanthin as a color additive, the labeling of the bulk fish container, including a list of ingredients, displayed on the retail container or by other written means. PLEASE INCLUDE “PASTEURIZED” ON THE JUICE LABELS.
